The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Solanus]] was covered in a '''sentient ocean'''. The [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] was rich in chemicals, which caused billions of thought processes to occur within its depths. It often kept to itself and contemplated its existence, keeping itself busy by creating and reforming [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] structures. It refused to participate in major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] affairs and was classified as a [[super-brain]].
